shots.prompt: The vast archive of glowing jars, a faint dawn glow far above
lines: NARRATOR
The last night. Dawn was coming. And so was the Shadow.

shots.prompt: Mira and Theo run down the archive aisle toward a bright light
A huge round chamber at the heart of the archive, a giant glass jar in the centre, silver stars swirling around it
Mira steps into the great chamber, turning slowly, amazed
lines: NARRATOR
Every dream that was ever dreamed ended here.

shots.prompt: Mira looking up in awe
lines: MIRA
This is the heart of the Archive. Every dream ends up here.

shots.prompt: The tall shadow in a wide hat descends a dark stone staircase
Theo grips his flashlight and steps in front of Mira
The tall shadow in the wide hat, face hidden in darkness
lines: SHADOW
Give me the light. I will put it to sleep, like all the others.

shots.prompt: Theo stands in front of Mira
lines: THEO
No way. You'll have to get past me. And my flashlight.

shots.prompt: Elias calm and kind
lines: ELIAS
Old friend. You don't have to do this anymore.

shots.prompt: Elias walks forward slowly, candle held out, calm
A tall figure in a dark cloak slowly takes off his wide hat, revealing a tired old man with a grey beard and sad kind eyes
The old man speaks sadly
lines: SHADOW
I silenced dreams so no one would feel the pain I felt. I was so alone.

shots.prompt: Mira lowers the lantern and takes a step toward the old man
Mira gentle, reaching out
lines: MIRA
You're not alone. Dreams hurt sometimes. That's how we know they matter.

shots.prompt: The old man looks at Mira, his hard face slowly softening
lines: NARRATOR
No one had spoken to him kindly in a very long time.

shots.prompt: A silver ribbon of light floats out of the brass lantern toward a giant glass jar
Mira calling softly
lines: MIRA
Lumen, you don't belong in a jar. You belong with me.

shots.prompt: Mira opens the lantern door wide, smiling, letting go
A ribbon of silver light flows gently into the chest of the girl, she glows softly and smiles with closed eyes
All the jars in the archive light up golden at once, musical notes floating
lines: NARRATOR
And for the first time in years, every jar in the Archive began to sing.

shots.prompt: Theo spins around laughing as golden light rains down
Elias joyful
lines: ELIAS
She did it. She brought her dream home.

shots.prompt: Two old archivists, one with long silver hair in green robe and one with grey beard in dark cloak, embrace among glowing golden jars
Elias laughs with tears in his eyes, arms open
Theo tired and happy
lines: THEO
So we saved every dream in the city. Can we sleep now?

shots.prompt: Mira laughing
lines: MIRA
Yes, Theo. Now we can finally dream.

shots.prompt: Mira and Theo walk out of the archive into the dawn light, laughing
Sunrise over the old city rooftops, golden light
Mira sleeps peacefully, smiling, the lantern glowing softly by her bed
lines: NARRATOR
That night, Mira dreamed. And she remembered every second.

shots.prompt: Anna in the morning kitchen, loving
lines: ANNA
Good morning, my star. Did you sleep well?

shots.prompt: Mira happy in the kitchen
lines: MIRA
I dreamed of Dad. And it didn't hurt. It was beautiful.

shots.prompt: Mira hugs her mother in the morning sunlight, both laughing
In the dark archive one new glass jar on a shelf slowly begins to glow purple
lines: NARRATOR
But deep in the Archive, a new jar began to glow.
